description: Create a template concept and display it in interactive 3D. Preferred for a quick initial design: creates a project if omitted, submits one durable geometry job and waits briefly for its viewer. No account check or full catalogue scan needed. For an unspecified GPU cold-plate concept use cold_plate; it is a simple parallel-channel concept, not a verified GPU package layout. Preserve explicit requirements; use get_template for customised parameters. Reuse the same key/arguments on network retry. Pending results continue with get_design_preview. This creates geometry only, with no mesh or simulation.

design_brief_artifact_id.description: Immutable owned design brief used to derive this candidate; retained in job lineage

document.description: Self-contained gd.design/v1 feature graph, up to 1 MiB. Use native design catalogue/edit operations to compose it. Mutually exclusive with template_id; assets/external references are not supported. Native validity, manufacturing and exact export are checked by the worker.

idempotency_key.description: Use a fresh unique key for each newly requested job, even with identical inputs or a matching completed job. Reuse unchanged only for retries/resuming that same intended job. Never replace it to retry an uncertain submission.

method.description: Exact STEP by default. For purpose=meshing, auto permits checked faceted STEP for implicit volumes; artifacts record the actual representation.

named_stl.description: Also export each selected document body as a separate named STL, alongside the combined surface, for mesh wall patches.

purpose.description: Meshing requires explicit volume output_names; heatmaps, boundary patches and display helpers are rejected by the geometry engine.

template_id.description: Registered template; mutually exclusive with document

name: create_design_preview
title: Preview a design
